resources.string: Update the Termux retui helper to 0.4.2 for workspace pages and shell exit detection. Existing windows are unchanged.

Termux helper update required\n\nThis Launcher needs helper %1$s. Update now installs the matching helper bundled with this app and reconnects the bridge. Existing shells and jobs are kept. A previous helper copy is retained for recovery. Any custom helper at this path will be replaced.
Updating helper · existing shells and jobs are kept

Termux setup required\n\nInstall Termux, grant Launcher permission to run Termux commands, and enable allow-external-apps=true in Termux settings. The setup guide has instructions. No security settings are changed automatically.

Termux packages required

Install tmux, socat and gawk in Termux with: pkg install tmux socat gawk
Then retry. Your existing helper has not been changed.

Helper update failed\n\nThe update was not confirmed. Installation failures attempt to restore the previous helper; it is also retained under $PREFIX/share/retui/retui.previous. Retry or open the setup guide. Existing shells and jobs are not stopped.
Another helper update is running or was interrupted\n\nRetry shortly. If this persists, open the setup guide. Launcher will not delete an unknown update lock or start another installation.
No reply from Termux\n\nCheck command permission and allow-external-apps, then retry. A dispatched update may still finish inside Termux; no installation is automatically retried.
No shell windows · add a new shell
